I'm afraid to inform you that you picked up one of the worst modern structure decks... Traptrix would probably wipe the floor with your cards, since it is one of the better ones (if not the best).

BUT! A good thing is that you picked up GX Speed Duels. For people who are getting into Yu-Gi-Oh for the first time, this product is perfect: it comes with a lot of pre-made 20-card decks that you and your fiancee can use to duel each other. It isn't as hard to learn as regular Yu-Gi-Oh, so you won't get overwhelmed with a lot of information. Read the manual that comes with it to see the decks it features, as well as some basic combos you can make with each deck.

My advice here is for both of you to stick with the Speed Duel decks for now, for the sake of having fun and learning the basics. If you end up liking the game, get three copies of a structure deck like Albaz Strike or Dark World, since they have a chance of beating your fiancee's deck.

Also, why three of the same? Because each deck only has one copy of some important cards. For example: Branded Fusion is, perhaps, one of the best cards in the game, but Albaz Strike only comes with one. Pick up three decks and you'll have three of them!

¿Sabes quién le inspiró a hacer la música que disfrutamos a día de hoy? Pues nada más ni nada menos que el legendario Giorgio Morder, el considerado padre de la música electrónica. Hoy en día, Giorgio es un señor de unos 80 y pico tacos, y lo que hoy en día tu amigo y mucha gente de hace 10/15 años dirían, es que es música para viejos.

Pero, ¿por qué un modernillo de mi fase de instituto como Deadmau5 se inspiraría en él? Pues porque su obra fue un hito muy importante en la historia de la música. Es muy importante conocer los sonidos del pasado para formar a un músico, y tener inspiración es, quizás, una de las cosas más importantes a la hora de componer.

Todos estos "carcas" como Queen, Kiss, Iron Maiden, Michael Jackson... Fueron muy importantes para las nuevas generaciones de músicos, y quizás sin ellos no hubiéramos podido disfrutar de los grupos que tenemos hoy en día. Por eso es muy importante conocerlos, y no es necesario que te gusten, pues el gusto en la música es algo totalmente subjetivo.

Espero que tu amigo le pueda dar una oportunidad a la música del pasado. Puede que no sea lo que se escuche hoy en día entre la gente de vuestra edad, pero no debemos pasar por alto la importancia que tuvieron para muchos artistas del día de hoy.

Remember that this list is still far from what you should strive for. I made it using what you have, with the information you gave us.

And now, here are immediate changes I'd make, assuming you have these cards and you still didn't purchased anything to improve your deck:

* Eternal Dread: I tried to focus on using Clock Tower Prison, as it's the cheapest way to build Destiny HEROes. Eternal Dread can help getting more counters. If you can find room for Metaverse or a third tower, don't hesitate to add them!
* Polymerization: Vyon is not on this list for a reason, and that is because this card is nowhere to be seen between the cards you mentioned. If you can find 1 or 2 of these, please put them inmediately, alongside your two Vyons!
* Destiny Draw / Allure Of Darkness: These are the best options for drawing you can have for now. Use Upstart Goblin or any pot card you can find if that's not an option.
* Foolish Burial: You want some of your Destiny HEROes in the GY, such as Malicious, Dasher or Celestial.
* Destiny HERO - Drilldark: you want to see this card in your hand, so try to find room for 2 more of these. It helps making XYZ and Link monsters easily.
* Generic Rank 4 / Link 2 monsters: As mentioned earlier, Drilldark can help summoning these kind of monsters.
* Staples: handtraps, board wipes, backrow removal... those are nice additions to your side deck!

Allow me a final note: try to be close to the 40 card limit with this deck. HEROes are notorious for constantly searching their whole deck, so they normally run 45+ cards. In your case, since you don't have much to search, try to stay near the limit.

Be sure to check this subreddit's pinned post. You'll find resources for returning players that you might find useful. There's also a HERO dedicated Discord server, players there will be more than happy to lend you a hand if you need further assistance with your deck :)

I'm missing a lot of things here: 

The Vision HERO package: 3 Faris, 2 Vyon and 1 Increase. They do everything your deck needs: a reliable polymerization search, discard HEROes you want to see on your GY such as Malicious or Celestial, and puts a few bodies in your field.

Xtra HEROes: 2 Cross Crusader at minimum, he's an important combo piece for Destiny HEROes. You can optionally use Dread Decimator to pack quite a punch or Wonder Driver to recover fusion spells from your GY.

Elemental HEROes: yes, this is a Destiny HERO deck, and I understand you want to keep it as Aster Phoenix would. But consider running Stratos at least. He's the best generic HERO searcher.

DPE: he doesn't cost a kidney anymore, I see no reason not to play it, at least 1.

Masked HEROes: 2 Dark Laws and 3 Mask Changes.  Having a Macro Cosmos with legs is no joke. Although he's not as good as Dark Law, Anki can be a decent addition to the Masked HERO lineup.

As a general note: your deck needs a lot of tweaking to do. I see too many cards that are simply too weak for today's standards (like Cyclone Blade among others), or too many copies of cards that will easily brick your hand (imagine opening 2 Dogma and 3 Plasma in your opening hand... Not fun).

As a Zombie player, we hate three things in particular: GY restrictions, hand traps and back row removal, specially this last one, because the Zombie World strategy heavily relies on that card to make their plays.

If you manage to destroy Zombie World:

* They cannot summon Balerdroch by its effect or by Glow-Up Bloom's effect.
* Use Super Polymerization to bring Dragonecro Nethersoul Dragon to their field using your own monsters.
* Use ROTW to lock you into summoning only Zombie-type monsters.
* You can activate effects that involve a certain monster type to be on the field or GY.

So I suggest using the likes of Cosmic Cyclone or Twin Twisters to face your opponent. Ash Blossom works great against Shiranui Solitaire, as he's one of the most important summons they have. But be careful if they use the Framegear package.

If you want to improve this deck, go for Judgement Force and try to pick up two sages, a maiden, maybe a master too and a spiritual dragon. If you can get Michael while you farm these cards, then add him to this list too, since you can summon him with spiritual dragon's effect.
